premise: On a snowy day Fox and Squirrel argue whose tail is best, the biggest or the bushiest, until tiny Caterpillar shivers in the snow — and both tails curl round her.
inspiration: The boast undone (Aesop's fables of vanity, like the peacock's tail), turned: nobody is humbled; the boast simply turns into kindness, and the best tail is the one round a friend.
lesson: The best thing about what you have is sharing it.
learning: Foxes and squirrels curl their bushy tails around them like a blanket in the cold.

en-US.title: The Warmest Tail
en-US.text: {canvas:snow 0.5 60s} {sfx:hush} Snowflakes were drifting down on the meadow. {fox:enter} Fox {fox:pulse} swished his tail. [excited] My tail is the biggest in the forest! {squirrel:enter} Squirrel came bounding up. {squirrel:face happy} Mine is the BUSHIEST! And she {squirrel:live} tucked her hazelnut behind her back, to show her tail off. Biggest! {squirrel:hop} Bushiest! {fox:hop} BIGGEST! {squirrel:wobble} BUSHIEST! {mouse:enter} Mouse, you choose! said Fox. Mouse {mouse:live} stood on tiptoe to look. Hmm… Then {fox:live hold} Fox's ears pricked up. [whispers] Shhh. What's that? {sfx:brrr} Brrr… brrr… It was little {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar, {caterpillar:shake} shivering in the snow. {caterpillar:tint #A8D8FF} {caterpillar:face sad} [softly] So cold, she said. {fox:live resume} Fox didn't say a word. {fox:go to caterpillar} He curled his big tail round her, the way foxes do on chilly nights. {squirrel:go to caterpillar} Squirrel curled hers round too, the way squirrels do. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:hearts} Warm at last, Caterpillar {caterpillar:live} looked up at the snowflakes. Well? said Mouse. Which tail is best? {fox:face happy} {squirrel:face happy} [happily] Both, said Caterpillar. Snug as a bug.

es-ES.title: La cola más calentita
es-ES.text: {canvas:snow 0.5 60s} {sfx:hush} Caían copos de nieve sobre el prado. {fox:enter} Zorro {fox:pulse} meneó la cola. [excited] ¡Mi cola es la más grande del bosque! {squirrel:enter} Ardilla llegó dando saltos. {squirrel:face happy} ¡Pues la mía es la más PELUDA! Y {squirrel:live} se escondió la avellana a la espalda, para lucir la cola. ¡La más grande! {squirrel:hop} ¡La más peluda! {fox:hop} ¡GRANDE! {squirrel:wobble} ¡PELUDA! {mouse:enter} ¡Ratón, elige tú! dijo Zorro. Ratón {mouse:live} se puso de puntillas para mirar. Mmm… Entonces Zorro {fox:live hold} levantó las orejas. [whispers] Chsss. ¿Qué es eso? {sfx:brrr} Brrr… brrr… Era la pequeña {caterpillar:enter} Oruga, {caterpillar:shake} tiritando en la nieve. {caterpillar:tint #A8D8FF} {caterpillar:face sad} [softly] Qué frío, dijo. {fox:live resume} Zorro no dijo nada. {fox:go to caterpillar} La rodeó con su gran cola, como hacen los zorros en las noches frías. {squirrel:go to caterpillar} Ardilla la rodeó con la suya, como hacen las ardillas. {caterpillar:face happy} {caterpillar:hearts} Calentita por fin, Oruga {caterpillar:live} miró los copos. ¿Y bien? dijo Ratón. ¿Cuál es la mejor cola? {fox:face happy} {squirrel:face happy} [happily] Las dos, dijo Oruga. Estoy como en una camita.
